name: Bayamón (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: White field with a blue Nordic cross edged in yellow, in the manner of the Finnish flag, in the colours of the municipal arms.
history: Bayamón is a city and municipality in the San Juan metropolitan area of Puerto Rico. The flag, embroidered by Gloria M. León, keeps the design and colours of the coat of arms; the Municipal Assembly officially approved it on 29 March 1977, correcting errors in the arms described in Resolution No. 59 of 8 April 1971.
